pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   C. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

4. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   B. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

10. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   C. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   D. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. C — Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A — Explain symbols used on a map

4. D — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Plan income and spending wisely

7. D — Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Mass Wasting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Water Cycle and Action of Rivers; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
